analysis.visual_description: Your cue-strip at the head, in the tiring-house, before the afternoon. The title is the whole of what the strip shows at its top. No book of the play. No face.
The same strip, a run of cues in another hand, none of them a king. The yard is not in the frame. No face.
The strip set on the chest. The afternoon is done. The flag-line is not on the paper. No face.
